Frequently Asked Questions

Our Support Team is available 24/7 via live chat.

What’s the max daily drawdown?

Max Daily Drawdown is 5% on all Pro and Classic Challenges and Funded Accounts. It is 3% on the One Phase Challenge and Funded Accounts. The Daily Drawdown is balance based for all accounts and is calculated at the start of the day (5:00 p.m. EST).

What’s the max overall drawdown?

Max Overall Drawdown is 10% on Pro and Classic Challenges and Funded Accounts. It is 6% on the One phase Challenges and Funded Accounts. The Overall Drawdown is calculated on your initial account balance (i.e. if you start a $100k Classic Challenge it will be $10k) and the equity is taken into account (i.e. also unrealized losses).

How frequently can I request a reward?

Once you have a Pro Funded Account with the daily rewards option, you can request a reward every time your account is in profit of at least 1% on the original account balance (e.g. 101k on a 100k account). You can also request multiple rewards in a day.

For Pro Funded accounts with the weekly rewards option, you can request a reward once a week when your account is in profit of at least 1% on the original account balance (e.g. 101k on a 100k account).

For One Phase and Classic Funded Accounts you can request a reward every two weeks, with the option to claim the first reward after one week with the add-on at checkout. The minimum reward for One Phase and Classic accounts is $100, not 1% of the initial balance.

All reward requests are subject to eligibility checks, review, and approval in accordance with the applicable trading rules.

Approved rewards are typically processed within one business day, and the average reward processing time is approximately 8 hours.

What about news and weekend holding?
News trading and news holding is allowed on all phases of all simulated trading Challenges. News trading and news holding is forbidden on Funded Accounts, unless you purchase the Swing add-on at checkout.
 
You cannot hold positions open over the weekend, unless you purchase the Swing add-on at checkout.
 
Swing add-on: you can purchase it at checkout and it allows you to trade and hold over news also on Funded Accounts. The Swing add-on also allows you to hold positions and trade crypto over the weekend.
Can I use EAs and Trading Bots?

Yes, you can use your own EAs and bots on all trading platforms. It is important that you own the code of the EA or bot.

Are there any hidden rules or fees?

No. The only fee payable is the initial simulated trading Challenge fee. There are no additional or hidden fees beyond those disclosed at checkout and in our Terms and Conditions. Subject to eligibility and approval under the applicable trading rules, the Challenge fee may be added to your first reward after you get funded and once the relevant requirements are met. There are no additional rules beyond those stated in our Terms and Conditions.

Are there countries I cannot trade from?

Unfortunately, we are unable to offer access to our simulated trading programs to users located in the countries listed below. Please note that this list may change from time to time based on the Company’s internal compliance requirements.

We are unable to offer our services to users located in the following countries: Afghanistan, Belarus, Central African Republic, Congo (the Democratic Republic of), Cuba, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Libya, Mali, Myanmar (Burma), North Korea, Somalia, Sudan, Syria, The Russian Federation, Donetsk Region of Ukraine, Zaporizhzhia Region of Ukraine, Luhansk Region of Ukraine, Kherson Region of Ukraine, Crimea Region of Ukraine, Sevastopol Region of Ukraine, Venezuela, Yemen, South Sudan.
